<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/delivery.ts -->
<!--
  The stores of a shop: name, a badge of its kind (pickup or store only), address, hours, phone, a note and the
  services. Axes: layout (cards, list: one row per store, map: compact cards beside a map picture), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Store, StoreLabels } from "./store-locations.types";

  export type StoreLocationsProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    stores: Store[];
    kinds: Record<string, string>;
    labels: StoreLabels;
    layout?: "cards" | "list" | "map";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { at, cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    stores,
    kinds,
    labels,
    layout = "cards",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: StoreLocationsProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Box
    class={cn(
      "grid grid-cols-1 gap-8",
      (((layout as string) === "map") ? "items-start md:grid-cols-2" : "")
    )}
  >
    <Box
      class={
        (layout as string) === "cards" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2"
        : "flex flex-col gap-4"
      }
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each stores as s (s.id)}
        <Stack
          gap="4"
          class={
            (layout as string) === "list" ? "border-b border-border pb-4"
            : "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6"
          }
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Badge variant="outline" size="default" class="w-fit">
              {at(kinds, s.kind)}
            </Badge>
            <Title as={3} size="lg" weight="bold">
              {s.name}
            </Title>
          </Stack>
          <List
            tag="ul"
            class={
              (layout as string) === "list" ? "flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-2 text-sm"
              : "flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm"
            }
          >
            <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <LucideIcon name="map-pin" size={16} />
              <Inline>
                {s.address}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
            <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <LucideIcon name="clock" size={16} />
              <Inline>
                {s.hours}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
            <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <LucideIcon name="phone" size={16} />
              <Link href={tpl("tel:{0}", s.phone)} variant="default">
                {(s.phone ?? "").replaceAll(" ", "\u00a0")}
              </Link>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
          {#if ((layout as string) === "cards")}
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {s.note}
            </Text>
            <Group gap="2" class="flex-wrap">
              {#each s.services as v (v)}
                <Badge variant="secondary" size="default">
                  {v}
                </Badge>
              {/each}
            </Group>
          {/if}
        </Stack>
      {/each}
    </Box>
    {#if ((layout as string) === "map")}
      <Box class="md:sticky md:top-8">
        <MediaFrame alt={labels.map} ratio="1/1" />
      </Box>
    {/if}
  </Box>
</SectionFrame>
